propositions: 108 store tickets carry Success Criteria bullets instead of Acceptance Criteria checkboxes, making them invisible to the AC count floor and unable to carry operator attestation tags.

A migration script must convert Success Criteria blocks to Acceptance Criteria checklist items via rebar.edit_ticket, preserving auditability while defaulting to closed tickets only to avoid silently invalidating in-flight plan-review claims.
The rewrite must be order-agnostic and idempotent, handling both Success-before-Acceptance and Acceptance-before-Success orderings, as well as qualified heading variants.
After migration, every affected ticket must return _count_ac_items >= 1 and contain no remaining Success Criteria heading, verified by post-run assertion over the live store.
